$comment: Pins the SQL Editor Pro extension revision that release builds bundle.
scripts/resolve-pro.mjs checks this ref out after cloning, so building a host
tag reproduces the exact extension that tag shipped. Without a pin the build
silently takes the Pro repo's default-branch HEAD, which means re-packaging an
old tag would ship newer extension code.
Bump `ref` whenever the Pro extension changes, and re-run
`node scripts/publish-pro-prebuilt.mjs` if you also maintain the prebuilt release.
